headline: Binance Halts Withdrawals Following $6.3 Billion Cyberattack
summary: Hackers stole approximately $6.3 billion from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, prompting the platform to suspend withdrawals while maintaining segregated client funds and FBI attention.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, and major security breaches pose systemic contagion risks to digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Massive exchange hacks and withdrawal freezes introduce regulatory scrutiny and panic across crypto markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion dollar breach on a leading crypto exchange triggers widespread fear, uncertainty, and liquidity lockups across digital assets.
